# Pipeline Kit

> Portable operating model for coding agents. Process lives in `.pipeline`. Six components, two kits, cookbooks for real use cases.

## Introduction
- [What is Pipeline Kit](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/what-is-pipeline-kit): Product definition, six components, get started.
- [Problems we solve](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/problems): Context explosion through governance; each links to a cookbook.
- [Architecture](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/architecture): Pack, orchestrator, hooks, gates, and what is roadmap.
- [How it works](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/how-it-works): Pack vs adapter, workflows, allowlists, config overlay.
- [Who it is for](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/who-it-is-for): New users, developers, architects, maintainers.
- [Repository layout](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/intro/repo-layout): Source map of the kit repo.

## Components
- [Components overview](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/components/overview): Workflows, packages, plugins, capabilities, testing, governance.
- [Packages](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/components/packages): assess and memory installable extras.
- [Testing and evaluation](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/components/testing): Product runners + agent-run scores.
- [Governance and portal](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/components/governance): Gates, licensing, enterprise portal.
- [Capabilities catalog](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/overview): Core vs opt-in surfaces.
- [Two kits](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/modes): Pack vs orchestrator.
- [Workflows](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/workflows): Named procedures and change classes.
- [Plugins](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/plugins): Graphify, Archify, obs note.
- [Knowledge](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/knowledge) · [Memory](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/memory) · [Observability](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/observability) · [Portal](https://pipeline.marketing91.shop/docs/capabilities/portal)
